general.description: Manage login methods, the multi-factor policy and OIDC providers for the administration login.

methods.cardSubtitle: Control which login methods are available and how they may be used.
methods.yamlGateHint: Methods disabled in the shopware.admin_auth configuration file stay off no matter what is enabled here.

webauthn.name: Passkey
webauthn.description: Passwordless sign-in with a passkey or security key (WebAuthn).

totp.name: Authenticator app (TOTP)
totp.description: Time-based one-time codes from an authenticator app, used as a second factor.

recovery_codes.name: Recovery codes
recovery_codes.description: One-time backup codes used as a fallback second factor.

methods.loadError: Could not load the login methods.
methods.saveError: Could not save the login methods.

policy.cardSubtitle: Control how the second-factor challenge behaves during login.
policy.enforcementYamlHint: Who has to complete a second factor is enforced via the shopware.admin_auth.mfa configuration file.
policy.ttlHelp: How long a pending second-factor challenge stays valid before it expires.

list.title: OIDC providers
list.emptySubline: Add an OpenID Connect provider to let admins sign in with an external identity provider.

managed.bannerText: Providers are declared in the shopware.admin_auth.providers configuration file. Database providers are ignored and cannot be edited here.

detail.title: OIDC provider
detail.activeHelp: Inactive providers are hidden from the login screen and cannot be used.
detail.priorityHelp: Higher numbers appear first on the login screen.
detail.clientCardSubtitle: The OAuth2 client registered with your identity provider.
detail.clientSecretKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the stored secret
detail.clientSecretHelpText: Stored encrypted. Leave empty when editing to keep the current secret.
detail.endpointsCardSubtitle: Where Shopware talks to your identity provider.
detail.discoverHint: Enter the issuer or discovery URL and click Auto-discover to fill the endpoints from the provider's OpenID configuration.
detail.discoverMissingUrl: Enter the provider's discovery URL first.
detail.discoverError: Could not discover the provider configuration.
detail.issuerHelp: The id_token issuer claim must match this value.
detail.scopesHelp: The OAuth2 scopes requested from the provider.
detail.autoProvisionHelp: Create a new admin user automatically when the verified email has no match.
detail.autoProvisionWarning: Anyone who can sign in to your identity provider with a verified email will get an account. Only enable this for trusted, internal providers.
detail.groupsClaimHelp: The id_token claim that contains the user's groups. Required for the role mapping below.
detail.defaultRolesHelp: Roles every user of this provider receives on login, regardless of their groups.

roleMapping.cardSubtitle: Map identity provider groups to Shopware ACL roles.
roleMapping.authoritativeSyncHint: This mapping is synced authoritatively on every login: roles granted by the sync are removed again when the user loses the group. Manually assigned roles are never touched.
